fields.climate: dry continental to polar in high Tien Shan Mountains; subtropical in southwest (Fergana Valley); temperate in northern foothill zone
fields.terrain: peaks of the Tien Shan mountain range and associated valleys and basins encompass the entire country
fields.hazards: major flooding during snow melt; prone to earthquakes
fields.resources: abundant hydropower; gold, rare earth metals; locally exploitable coal, oil, and natural gas; other deposits of nepheline, mercury, bismuth, lead, and zinc
fields.farm: milk, potatoes, maize, sugar beets, wheat, barley, tomatoes, onions, watermelons, carrots/turnips
fields.exports: gold, coal, precious metal ore, refined petroleum, garments
fields.industries: small machinery, textiles, food processing, cement, shoes, lumber, refrigerators, furniture, electric motors, gold, rare earth metals
fields.languages: Kyrgyz (state language) 71.4%, Uzbek 14.4%, Russian (official language) 9%, other 5.2%
fields.religions: Muslim 90% (majority Sunni), Christian 7% (Russian Orthodox 3%), other 3% (includes Jewish, Buddhist, Baha'i)
fields.legal: civil law system that includes features of French civil law and Russian Federation laws
fields.military: 18-27 years of age for compulsory or voluntary service for men in the Armed Forces or Interior Ministry…
